title: Quanzhi Gaoshou: Rongyao Xiao Juchang
synopsis:
Ye Xiu and his friends encountered the sports meet on their second day of school, engaging in a series of witty and courageous teamwork and athletic competitions. The children trained in groups...long jump, tug-of-war, three-legged race, fishing, dodgeball, skiing, tire spinning, snowball fights, snow bowling, snow fun, snow treasure hunts, and more. Through the games and competitions of kindergarten children, the animation showcases the ubiquitous nature of athletic events and the spirit of competition, demonstrating the protagonist's teamwork and joyful growth with his friends.

(Source: Bangumi, translated)
